name: Novo Nordisk
scopeText:
ENGAGEMENT: Enterprise GEO strategic advisory & program support post-Profound onboarding (US market). Advisory/consultative in nature.

D1 — ENTERPRISE GEO OPERATING MODEL & ROADMAP
• GEO organizational & governance recommendations (competency + operating model)
• Cross-functional workflow, stakeholder alignment & agency coordination guidance
• GEO maturity roadmap across consumer, HCP and clinical AI surfaces
• Executive alignment materials & advisory sessions (marketing, digital, analytics, medical)
• Regional guidance differentiating US vs. global AI-search priorities
• GEO playbook components: prompt governance, AI-ready content principles, visibility measurement

D2 — CENTRALIZED PROMPT INTELLIGENCE & AI VISIBILITY
• Prompt engineering workshops aligned to GEO objectives & therapeutic priorities
• Reusable prompt frameworks, templates & taxonomy structures; ongoing library maintenance
• Prompt-based benchmarking & AI visibility analysis via Profound
• Competitive visibility benchmarking across priority brands & therapy areas
• Strategic insight & recommendation readouts on AI visibility trends
• Periodic GEO performance review & optimization planning sessions

D3 — PROGRAM GOVERNANCE & COORDINATION
• Project planning, milestone tracking, governance workflows & execution coordination
• Cross-functional coordination (strategy, analytics, content, web, medical, compliance, agencies)
• Demand intake, prioritization & dependency tracking
• RAID tracking: risks, dependencies, escalations, mitigation
• Governance cadence: status reporting, working sessions, stakeholder reviews
• Maintenance of governance documentation, trackers, action logs & program records

TEAM: GEO Strategist (0.5 FTE, 12+ yrs) | AI Optimization Specialist / Prompt Engineer (1 FTE, 9+ yrs) | Program Manager (1 FTE, 18+ yrs)

KEY BOUNDARIES:
• Capped at up to 5 priority Novo Nordisk brands
• English-language, priority US-market AI search environments only
• EXCLUDES large-scale technical implementation, CMS development, engineering, production deployment ownership & ongoing managed services
• No guarantee of specific rankings, citations or AI answer inclusion (probabilistic by nature)
• Regional expansion / localization / multilingual analysis requires scope reassessment
• New brands, AI platforms or deliverables require formal change control

ACCEPTANCE: NN PM approval; feedback within 5 business days; rework at no charge.
CHANGE CONTROL: Formal Change Order per MSA. Ramp-up 60 days notice; ramp-down 90 days notice.
COMMERCIALS (per SOW): Not to exceed $512,800 in 2026 | Term 18-May-2026 to Dec-2026 | MSA effective 18-May-2025

name: AbbVie
scopeText:
ENGAGEMENT: AbbVie — Immunology GEO Assessment & Reporting Program.
Brands: SKYRIZI & RINVOQ. Duration: 4–5 weeks (Week 0 = 7-Sep-2026 through
Week 5 = 12-Oct-2026).

SCOPE:
• Establish the GEO assessment and measurement approach for SKYRIZI and
  RINVOQ as an enterprise capability, with enterprise dashboards in Profound
• Assess AI visibility, source use, accuracy and competitive presence across
  priority questions on 5 AI platforms and up to 10 indications
• Assess unbranded content source presence across agreed DSA web properties
  for disease-state questions, incl. visibility vs competitor sources
• Conduct technical GEO hygiene audit across 19 web properties
• Synthesize findings into prioritized GEO recommendations and next-phase
  opportunities across owned, earned and technical areas
• Conduct 2 deep-dive readouts for SKYRIZI and RINVOQ (gaps & opportunities)
• Bring outside-in perspective and best practices prior to scaling

WORKSTREAMS & TIMELINE:
• W0 — Scope, Methodology & Alignment: scope, indication & enterprise
  capability alignment; assessment methodology & KPI alignment
• W1 — Prompt Library & Assessment Readiness: prompt library & Profound
  setup initiation; enterprise dashboards & assessment readiness
• W2–3 — Baseline Assessment & Diagnostics: assessment for 10 indications
  across branded, DSA and pre-launch
• W4 — Insights & Synthesis: consolidated indication-level insights in brand
  report; findings synthesis & validation
• W4 — Recommendations & Prioritization: key opportunity identification;
  recommendation prioritization; claim accuracy using Profound setup
• W5 — SKYRIZI & RINVOQ brand readouts & next-phase discussion

DELIVERABLES:
• GEO briefing per brand: prompt methodology, measurement approach, scoring
  framework and reporting requirements
• Profound setup: enterprise dashboards, prompts uploaded and tagged by
  indication, accuracy, visibility and sentiment
• Accuracy Mapping for indication label claims (prompts)
• Analysis and Insights for SKYRIZI and RINVOQ covering indication findings
• Prioritized GEO findings, gaps and recommendations with best practices
• Executive readout for SKYRIZI and RINVOQ

MILESTONES: M1 Briefing & scope alignment · M2 Label and claim accuracy
mapping · M3 Prompt library & Profound setup ready · M4 Profound enterprise
dashboards live with accuracy scores · M5 Assessment & audit execution ·
M6 Recommendations prioritized & insights ready · M7 First draft analytical
reports · M8 Next-phase roadmap confirmed.

TEAM: Rusty Rahmer (Strategy & Outcomes Lead) · Prasad Adavadkar
(Engagement Lead) · Ambika Singh (GEO Lead) · Arunima Chandra (GEO
Strategist) · Dr. Ayushi Gadekar (Medical SME) · Abhishek Sharma (AIO
Specialist). Support: Rashprit / Arunima / Anshul / Mohit / Analyst / Ayushi.

KEY BOUNDARIES (OUT OF SCOPE):
• Technical hygiene audit is out of scope (per Assumptions slide — NOTE:
  conflicts with Project Charter which lists a 19-property audit; confirm)
• Crawl analytics (ChatGPT/Gemini bot logs, AI bot readability per page)
• Additional KPIs beyond agreed framework (hallucination rate, source
  inclusion, recommendation strength)
• Specific efficacy-claim logic — requires separate agent build (future)
• Phase 1 is assessment, insights and prioritized recommendations only;
  execution, content development, technical remediation and re-testing
  will be scoped separately

KEY ASSUMPTIONS:
• AbbVie provides the baseline prompt/question set; Indegene reviews,
  structures, tags, validates and prioritizes for assessment readiness
• 400 prompts total — 200 per brand; AbbVie to provide competitor list
• Indegene Profound instance: max 10 competitors/brand, 4 AI platforms and
  200 prompts per configuration (usage inclusive in fee)
• Results are a point-in-time baseline; AI answers vary across engines/time
• Effort sizing is directional, not an implementation commitment

RISKS & DEPENDENCIES:
• Claim accuracy requires timely Medical and Measurement lead alignment
• Prompt setup starts only on receipt of client prompts — delay hits timeline
• Profound data stability: prompt data 3–4 days; Fact Check 8–9 days
• Timely access to approved brand, clinical and disease-state materials
• Confirmation of priority indications, audiences, competitors, properties
• Brand/Medical review of prompts, narratives and accuracy findings on time
• One consolidated feedback route; daily/weekly governance checkpoints
• Confirmation of reporting format, KPI definitions and scoring rules

COMMERCIALS (per proposal): Total investment $208,000, inclusive of 10
indications across both brands and Indegene Profound instance usage.
Additional prompt volume, AI platform usage or agent credits require
separate configuration and pass-through cost. T&E billed on actuals.

name: Pfizer
scopeText:
ENGAGEMENT: Pfizer — BESPONSA (inotuzumab ozogamicin) GEO Implementation
Roadmap. R/R B-cell Precursor ALL, HCP audience (besponsa.pfizerpro.com).
NOTE: This is a delivery roadmap / implementation plan, not an executed SOW —
tracker SOW Status is "N/A". All dates below are stated as working targets.
Duration: ~10 weeks (W1 19-Aug-2026 through W10 21-23 Oct 2026).

TRACK 1 — FOUNDATION ENHANCEMENTS (4-week plan, backend/technical only):
Operating model per item = Indegene recommends -> Pfizer reviews & approves ->
Pfizer Web Team implements -> Indegene post-live QC validation.
• H1 tags: identify missing/duplicate/unrelated H1s; page-specific H1s aligned
  to HCP intent (Rec 19-25 Aug; Impl 26 Aug-03 Sep; QC 04 Sep)
• Heading structure H1-H6: map and optimize hierarchy (same cadence)
• Schema markup: JSON-LD templates for key entities — MedicalWebPage, Drug,
  MedicalCondition, MedicalAudience, DoseSchedule, Organization
  (Rec 26 Aug-01 Sep; Impl 02-10 Sep; QC 11-12 Sep)
• Robots.txt & sitemap optimization: crawler rules for approved AI bots
  (Rec 20-21 Aug; Impl 22-27 Aug; QC 28 Aug)
• Make image & table content accessible (image-to-HTML conversion of already
  MLR-approved efficacy, dosing and AE tables)
MILESTONE 1 — Foundation Updates Live & Validated — 11 Sep 2026

PRIORITY MATRIX (sequencing under limited Pfizer web/MLR bandwidth):
• #1 robots.txt — P0 Gate, low effort (1-2d); needs Legal/Privacy, not MLR
• #2 image & table accessibility — P0 Keystone, med-high; unlocks #3 and #4
• #3 heading structure H1-H6 — P1 Scaffolding, low-med; depends on #2
• #4 unique page-specific H1s — P1 Anchoring, low (2d); depends on #2
• #5 medical & content schema — P2 Amplifier, med; delivers most after #2
All five are existing-content, under-the-hood changes requiring no new MLR.

TRACK 2 — AS-IS & GEO ASSESSMENT (10 weeks):
• WS1 Understand Brand Priorities: brand strategy, HCP objectives, evidence and
  competitive positioning review; HCP content assessment; joint working session
  (19-24 Aug; 25-28 Aug) — CHECKPOINT 2.a brand priorities aligned
• WS2 AI Visibility & Narrative Assessment: define narratives BESPONSA must own
  (29 Aug-03 Sep); client session to prioritize narrative battles (04-06 Sep);
  prompt library creation — intent mapping, clustering, journey-aligned prompt
  architecture (07-12 Sep); prompt review & approval (13-17 Sep); Profound
  platform setup — tracking, prompts, competitor brands (18-26 Sep)
  — CHECKPOINT 2.b Narratives signed off & Profound setup — 26 Sep 2026
• WS3 Baseline & Opportunity Landscape: AI visibility baseline (citation rate,
  Share of Model, cross-platform visibility) 27-30 Sep; competitive
  benchmarking; gap & opportunity analysis 01-05 Oct; authority & citation
  analysis; opportunity synthesis & final assessment readout 19-23 Oct
MILESTONE 2 — GEO Assessment Complete — 23 Oct 2026

TRACK 3 — RECOMMENDATIONS & PRIORITIZATION (W7-W10):
• Prioritize & score by impact, effort, feasibility, evidence strength and
  measurement potential -> priority scoring matrix (06-14 Oct)
• Define AI-native GEO KPIs, downstream indicators, owners and dependencies
  -> KPI and ownership framework (07-14 Oct)
• Build phased GEO implementation roadmap separating quick wins from
  higher-effort initiatives (14-20 Oct)
• Joint roadmap review, alignment and approval; confirm implementation scope
  and sequencing (21-27 Oct)
MILESTONE 3 — Roadmap Approved — 27 Oct 2026

GOVERNANCE: Scope & Assumptions Alignment 28-Aug-2026 · AI Weekly Call for
milestone updates (weekly/on milestone) · Interim Readout 13-Oct-2026 ·
Final Readout 27-Oct-2026. Pre-reads shared ahead of key discussions.

KEY BOUNDARIES (OUT OF SCOPE):
• Foundational enhancements are backend/technical changes only — no front-end
  content or creative changes in scope
• Indegene recommends and validates; Pfizer Web/Digital team implements
• Off-page/authority activities are recommendations only

KEY ASSUMPTIONS:
• Pfizer Web/Digital team capacity planned to support implementation
• Pfizer to confirm a single named point of contact for technical execution
• Recommendations adapted to Pfizer CMS and web platform requirements
• Implementation timelines may be re-baselined based on volume and complexity
  of recommendations identified

RISKS & DEPENDENCIES:
• Pfizer technical owner must be identified and engaged for implementation
• CMS/platform feasibility validation against current architecture
• Website impact: Pfizer to confirm deployment window, downtime or
  availability considerations
• Access to brand plan, evidence pack, gated content, Profound access/licence
• Legal/privacy/security governance sign-off for robots.txt
• Page inventory and web implementation slots from Pfizer

OPEN QUESTIONS FOR PFIZER:
• Will any BESPONSA HCP pages be taken down or experience downtime during
  implementation?
• What is the expected implementation window once specifications are handed off?

COMMERCIALS: No fees, rate card or contract value stated in this roadmap deck.
Tracker revenue of $190,000 is not evidenced by this document — confirm against
the underlying Pfizer SOW/PO.

scopeText:
ENGAGEMENT: Gilead Sciences S.r.l (Italy) — GEO AI Visibility Pilot
(Listening & Recommendations). Work Order under MSA between Gilead Sciences
Inc. and Indegene, Inc. effective 22-Sep-2015.
Term: 6 weeks from Effective Date. EFFECTIVE DATE IS "TBD" IN THE DOCUMENT.

COVERAGE MODEL: Italy market · 1 therapy area (Oncology) · 1 brand (Trodelvy) ·
1 gated HCP website · Italian language · HCP and Patient audiences.

D1 — EXTENSIVE & ROBUST PROMPT LIBRARY (Weeks 1-4):
• Keyword research and topic discovery
• Prompt construction across a 3-layer taxonomy (Gilead -> Therapy Area ->
  Brand)
• Cognitive Intent Funnel coverage: Exploration, Evaluation, Decision Support
  and Management
• Prompt engineering across HCP and Patient journeys
• Multi-LLM execution across ChatGPT, Gemini and Google AI Overviews
• Volume Heatmap and Segment Priority Index
• QA, compliance validation and client walkthrough

D2 — ANALYSIS & RECOMMENDATIONS READOUT (Weeks 3-6):
• AI Visibility Baseline via GEO Metrics Scorecard
• Platform-level comparative views and competitive benchmarking
• Third-party citation analysis with authority/influence scoring
• Governance and audit recommendations framework with source-priority matrix
• Insights synthesis and final executive readout with playbook handoff

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA:
• D1 — final prompt library in editable format plus methodology pack; client
  walkthrough completed and confirmation received
• D2 — final readout delivered with playbook handoff; client confirmation
  received. Gilead shall review and accept or reject each deliverable.

KEY BOUNDARIES (OUT OF SCOPE):
• Implementation or execution of recommendations
• Net-new content creation
• Full website overhaul beyond defined priority pages
• Markets outside Italy or non-Italian languages
• MLR submission management, workflows or approval cycles
• Paid media, social or campaign execution
• Third-party website updates, publisher outreach, backlink acquisition
• Live dashboards, continuous monitoring or always-on tracking
• Anything not explicitly defined — subject to formal Change Control

KEY ASSUMPTIONS:
• Engagement is diagnostic, analytical and advisory only — no implementation
• Third-party ecosystem: advisory only; no control over AI platform behaviour
• All outputs require Gilead MLR review; Indegene will not publish, deploy or
  modify any Gilead property
• No guarantee of visibility, ranking or citation improvements
• Proprietary GEO tools/accelerators are not licensed for ongoing independent
  use by Gilead
• 6-week timeline assumes timely Gilead dependencies; delays require
  re-baselining
• Gilead's Obligations section is marked NOT APPLICABLE

RISKS & DEPENDENCIES:
• EFFECTIVE DATE UNRESOLVED — document carries an open reviewer comment
  requiring an exact date; start date pending client confirmation of when the
  engagement commences. Term and all milestones float until this is fixed.
• Timely access to Gilead Materials and stakeholder availability
• MLR review capacity for all outputs

COMMERCIALS (per Work Order): Total Engagement Cost $39,400 fixed fee,
inclusive of a $2,250 tool/accelerator allocation, exclusive of taxes;
out-of-pocket at cost without markup. Fee breakup — Gilead Italy fee $25,000
+ Central Funding (CPC) $10,000 + Commercial Discount $4,400 = $39,400.
The Service Fees field states $25,000. Payment schedule: Payment 1 $12,500
(50%) upon Effective Date / kickoff; Payment 2 $12,500 (50%) end of Week 6.
Expenses budget: none (included in service fees). Invoiced against milestone
completion; payment within 30 days of receipt. Invoicing entity: Gilead
Sciences S.r.l, Via Melchiorre Gioia 26, 20124 Milan, Italy.
NOTE: Tracker revenue $35,000 matches neither $39,400 nor $25,000 — confirm.

name: Summit
scopeText:
ENGAGEMENT: Summit Therapeutics Inc. — Digital Commercial Operations.
SOW No. 1 under MSA dated 11-Apr-2026. Executed 21-Apr-2026.
Term: ~9 months from last signature through 31-Dec-2026.
Brand: Ivonescimab (single indication), launch and post-launch execution.

PURPOSE: Design, implement and operationalize core digital commercial
capabilities — a scalable, execution-ready digital operating model enabled by
foundational platforms, integrated data and omnichannel engagement.

WS1 — DEPLOY CORE PLATFORMS:
• Salesforce Marketing Cloud: instance provisioning; discovery & solution
  alignment; setup (3 business units, roles/permissions, private domain and
  dedicated IP); Contact Builder data model and data extensions; Journey
  Builder, triggered/batch sends, templates, automation workflows; API
  integrations with OneTrust, CRM, Drupal, GA360 and ON24; unit/integration
  testing and UAT; documentation, knowledge transfer and hypercare
  In scope: Email Studio/Builder, Mobile Studio (email use only), Content
  Builder, Journey Builder, Einstein as applicable, OOB analytics, ~45K
  contacts. Out: Agentforce, SMS/MMS short code procurement, mobile push,
  messaging apps, social channels, migration from incumbent platform.
• Additional platforms: Drupal, GA360, OneTrust, ON24

WS2 — ARCHETYPES, PERSONAS & JOURNEY PLANNING:
• Audience segment definition and omnichannel customer journey design,
  delivered in 5 phases on Tandem, Indegene's proprietary data and technology
  platform (platform fees included in this engagement)
• Out of scope: full HCP target list development, data licensing, content or
  derivative asset development, journey activation and campaign execution

WS3 — OMNICHANNEL CAMPAIGN ORCHESTRATION & OPERATIONS:
• Execution, management and optimization of campaigns across digital channels

WS4 — WEBSITE BUILD & DEPLOYMENT:
• Design, development, testing and deployment of the Summit digital DSE
  website; functional testing, UAT support and bug fixes

WS5 — TAGGING & TAXONOMY FRAMEWORK:
• GA4/GTM architecture design; event & parameter configuration spec; custom
  dimensions/metrics; GTM baseline container; third-party tag governance list;
  publish & change-control SOP; agency onboarding and training materials;
  tagging validation & QA report

WS6 — DIGITAL DATA LAYER & PERFORMANCE INSIGHTS:
• Measurement framework & KPI definitions; data dictionary; file interface
  agreements for inbound vendor feeds; Power BI dashboard; campaign
  performance reporting and insights; analytics-ready file feeds

WS7 — SEO/GEO STRATEGY, LISTENING & CONTENT OPTIMIZATION:
One-time — GEO strategy setup and listening foundation:
• DSE (unbranded) site: GenAI listening scan and GEO search landscape analysis
  for priority intents; SEO/GEO readiness assessment and strategy framework;
  prompt library (up to 200) for structured AI monitoring; competitive
  analysis and AI intelligence; technical readiness assessment for AI
  enablement and on-page SEO
• Launch phase (up to 2 branded splash pages + 2 branded sites, 1 HCP and
  1 Patient): GenAI listening and landscape analysis across branded
  properties; KPI, benchmark and success-metric definition for AI visibility
  and influence; evolved prompt library across sites and top contributing
  LLMs; SEO/GEO readiness assessment incl. content strategy and web
  optimizations; AI-focused schema and technical elements (structured data,
  metadata, robots.txt design, sitemap, E-E-A-T, crawlability controls);
  content and web recommendations for AI retrievability; GenAI listening
  dashboards with in-market benchmarks
• OpenEvidence: roadmap for publication in indexed journals; review and
  structure for ClinicalTrials.gov entries; multi-format repurposing plan and
  internal evidence ecosystem linking; roadmap for inclusion in major society
  guidelines (e.g. NCCN, ASCO)
• Post-launch maintenance: AI visibility and listening analysis incl. citation
  share and answer presence across engines (Excel-based dashboard); translate
  monitoring insights into actionable content and web directives

PROJECT SCHEDULE: 9 consecutive months from kick-off. Phase 1 — platform
setups; Phase 2 — omnichannel activation and launch preparation. Workplan and
prioritization developed with the Summit project sponsor in the initial weeks.

TEAM: Engagement Lead (0.5 US) · Technical Architect (0.5 US) · SFMC Tech Lead
· Tech Project Manager · Web Tagging & Campaign Tracking Lead · OneTrust
Consultant · Event Specialist, supported by offshore SMEs. Key personnel:
Jay Khan (VP), Puneet Singh (Client Partner), Debanka Nandi (Engagement Lead).
Summit representative: Jon Albert, ED Commercial Operations.

• Any new content creation incl. original copy, creative and multimedia
• Paid media or social campaign execution
• Management of MLR submissions, routing, annotations or approval cycles
• Prompt volume beyond the 200 cap — additional cost via Change Request

• Website updates executed within mutually agreed timelines
• All performance results depend on implementation of the recommendations
• Content creation depends on Summit's content team collaboration
• Summit responsible for all content, SOPs, data, target lists and materials

• Summit provides strategy documents, MarTech inventories and relevant

REGULATORY PAUSE CLAUSE: If regulatory considerations require the workstream
to be paused, Indegene will work with Summit for up to 3 weeks to develop a
halt-and-restart plan. Summit liable only for pre-approved, documented and
verifiable incremental costs directly resulting from stoppage and restart.

name: Stoke Theraupetics
scopeText:
ENGAGEMENT: Stoke Therapeutics Inc. — US Medical Affairs Portal (MVP build
and ongoing maintenance). Work Order IND-03-26-01673 under MSA dated
21-Oct-2025. Dated 08-May-2026. Kick-off 13-Jun-2026.
Timeline: MVP delivered in 16 weeks post kick-off; maintenance 8 months.

PURPOSE: A centralized, compliant, scalable platform for external medical
content, supporting pre-launch engagement and future advanced capabilities.

MVP CORE CAPABILITIES:
• Publishing of approved core scientific content (disease education,
  publications, congress materials)
• Integration with Veeva MedComms for approved assets
• Honesty Box based authentication and content access for external users
• SSO with Microsoft Entra for CMS and back-office administration
• Keyword search via Solr; WordPress content structured with Custom Post
  Types and Advanced Custom Fields for discoverability
• Cookie consent management
• DAMS librarian services for asset maintenance (tagging/hygiene) in Veeva
• Medical Inquiry intake workflow
• Web tagging and standard reporting
• Generative Engine Optimization (content assessment & advisory)
• Technical / on-page SEO

SERVICES:
a) MVP Medical Affairs website delivery — discovery, UX design, architecture
   design, modular WordPress development, testing & UAT, go-live support
b) SEO + GEO implementation for the MVP website
c) Program management and governance — SLA/KPI tracking and reporting
d) Medical Affairs SME & strategy/consulting expert hours (onshore)
e) Ongoing maintenance of the website post go-live

PART A — BUILD:
• Technical design and build on WordPress CMS with ReactJS/Angular UI;
  structured content model for modular reuse; seamless integration with the
  Stoke corporate website (navigation, UX, branding, handoffs)
• Functional testing, UAT support, MLR review support of draft site,
  go-live deployment. One round of edits based on MLR feedback.
• Security: role-based access control for HCP-gated medical content; HCP
  authentication via NPI registry or equivalent; MI form submissions
  transmitted via structured email to Stoke-designated addresses (Stoke to
  provide SMTP access and API credentials); encrypted in transit and at rest;
  OWASP Top 10 aligned secure coding; vetted WordPress plugins
• UI/UX: design workshops; IA, sitemap and core user flows signed off by end
  of Week 2; approx. 20-25 unique pages (shared layouts count as one
  template); desktop and mobile layouts with responsive tablet adaptation;
  Atomic Architecture principles; max 2 design revision cycles per template;
  LTR languages only; Figma handoff files and print-ready PDFs for MLR/PRC

SEO & GEO SCOPE:
• Discovery analysis: competitor landscape, US market and disease search
  behaviour, website architecture, user journey and content theme analysis
• AI listening: AI visibility benchmarking and competitor landscape assessment
• Prompt library: high-intent HCP prompts clustered across clinical, safety,
  dosing and trials parameters
• GEO strategy document: AI-readable content structuring standards for content
  teams, technical guidelines for web teams, measurement standards for
  analytics; incorporates WebMCP guidelines and public vs gated content
  strategy
• On-page recommendations: keyword research, meta titles and descriptions,
  OG tags, header tags, image ALT tags
• Schema markup and AI-focused technical elements: structured data, metadata,
  robots.txt design, sitemap, E-E-A-T elements, crawlability and extraction
  controls; OG and Twitter card tags
• UAT audit for pre-launch GEO readiness across content, schema and
  accessibility; technical SEO and accessibility checks during development
• Post-live technical SEO audit; post-launch AI listening and GEO audit
• Monitor and benchmark AI visibility incl. citation share and answer presence
  across engines; GEO performance reporting with actionable recommendations

PART B — MAINTENANCE (8 months): web technical maintenance capped at 120
hours per month; infra maintenance; GA/GTM tagging maintenance; schema markup
maintenance and minor enhancements; SEO support for standard content updates;
cookie banner and preference centre maintenance; DAMS-to-web integration
support; programme governance.

KEY BOUNDARIES (OUT OF SCOPE — MVP):
• NPI and/or email-based authentication for portal and content access
• AI-enabled or semantic search experiences; chatbot implementation
• Integration with data warehouse, marketing automation, webinar/event
  platforms; custom analytics and data visualization
• Off-page SEO; GEO-optimized content brief creation; content gap analysis;
  content optimization; advanced on-page SEO recommendations; link building
• Content creation beyond web copy; multi-language support; localization
• MLR submission and legal review; procurement of domain names
• Design system creation; separate custom tablet template
• SEO for net-new pages beyond agreed maintenance limits; AI/GEO strategy
  expansion beyond existing schema and structured data

KEY ASSUMPTIONS & DEPENDENCIES:
• Hosting: Stoke hosts on its own WordPress (WP Engine) environment; Stoke IT
  maintains hosting, security configuration and grants Indegene access. Any
  WP Engine configuration or licensing costs are Stoke's responsibility.
• Design files approved during discovery; solution, timelines and cost
  revisited at end of discovery phase
• BrowserStack licence provided by Stoke; latest two versions of major
  browsers supported
• Timeline depends on timely client approvals, feedback and deliverables;
  scope/timeline/feature changes go through formal change request
• Power BI available for dashboard development
• Licensed image costs borne by Stoke and billed separately

COMMERCIALS (per Work Order): Total $653,356, exclusive of taxes.
Breakdown — Core MVP development (discovery, design kit, platform build, UAT,
go-live) $301,370; Advanced Search Enablement & Website Visibility
acceleration (SEO + GEO) $44,990; Program management and Medical Affairs SME
/ strategy consulting onshore hours $131,100; ongoing portal maintenance
(web tagging, DAM, SEO & GEO optimizations, governance, page updates, consent
and integration support, 8 months) $175,896.
Total Build Amount $477,460, released against milestones — 5% on kick-off;
20% on completion of discovery & design (incl. competitive benchmarking
outcome report, approved tech solution, IA and final wireframes); 40% on
completion of web development ready for testing & UAT; 20% on completion of
SEO/GEO implementation, testing & UAT; 15% on website go-live.
Monthly invoicing; due on receipt, 60-day credit period, 1.5% monthly penalty
thereafter. Invoice schedule runs 13-Jun-2026 ($23,873) through 30-May-2027
($21,987), peaking at $190,984 on 30-Jul-2026.
NOTE: Tracker revenue $36,507 vs SOW total $653,356 (SEO/GEO slice $44,990)
— confirm which basis the tracker should carry.

name: Cingulate
scopeText:
ENGAGEMENT: Cingulate Therapeutics LLC — Websites Support.
SOW No. IND-09-25-01372 under MSA dated 07-May-2025. PO 1313.
Term: 01-Oct-2025 to 31-Jul-2026 (pre-launch duration). CTX1301 ENFOCUS.
End-to-end website build, design, deployment, GEO readiness and support.

WEBSITES IN SCOPE (4 properties):
• Brand — Splash Pages (pre-launch), up to 3–5 pages (Nov 25 – Apr 26)
• Brand / Patient site — launch site, up to 10 pages (Feb 26 – Jul 26)
• Brand HCP site — up to 15 pages (Jan 26 – Jul 26)
• Market Conditioning site — up to 5 pages; medical communication,
  podcasts, infographics, KOL videos (Nov 25 – Apr 26)

UX DESIGN:
• Splash pages: up to 3–5 desktop + 3–5 mobile (Nov 25 – Jan 26)
• Brand/Patient site: up to 10 desktop + 10 mobile (Nov 25 – Jan 26)
• Brand HCP site: up to 15 desktop + 15 mobile (Jan 26 – Mar 26)
• Market Conditioning site: up to 5 desktop + 5 mobile (Nov 25 – Jan 26)

BUILD & TECHNICAL SUPPORT:
• SEO Support — define SEO title tags and keywords for each page
• Web Analytics & Cookie Consent — enable Google Analytics; implement
  OneTrust cookie consent mechanism compliant with regulations
• Functional Testing — verify all features and functionalities work as
  intended; responsiveness across 2 major browsers and devices (BrowserStack)
• UAT Support — 2 rounds of UAT (staging review and quality control)
• Bug Fixes — address issues from functional testing and UAT feedback
• Deployment and Go-Live support; address immediate post-launch concerns
• Hypercare — two weeks of post-launch support

GENERATIVE ENGINE OPTIMIZATION (GEO):
• GEO / AIO Support: patient and HCP questions, intents and entities
  (target prompt research) (Jan 2026)
• GEO Testing & Benchmarking incl. competitor analysis (Feb–Mar 2026)
• AI-Ready Content & Metadata: optimize/organize content for Q&A snippets,
  summaries and FAQs; structure content using schema / structured data
  (Medical Webpage, Drug, FAQ) (Mar–May 2026)
• Functional Testing of AI responses on latest approved data, UAT (GEO) and
  remediation / bug fixes in AI answers (Apr–Jul 2026)
• GEO Hypercare & Monitoring (Jul 2026)

GEO WORK SCHEDULE: Review & preliminary analysis (Jan–Mar 26) · GEO analysis,
orchestration and implementation (Apr–Jun 26) · Orchestration, implementation
and tracking (Jul 26).

SERVICE LEVEL / KPIs TRACKED: Timeliness (% on-time completion, number of
schedule adjustments) · Quality & Cost (# errors, customer complaints,
schedule & effort variance) · Speed of delivery (effort hours, adherence to
timelines) · UAT (% requirements completion, defects raised/closed/open).

KEY BOUNDARIES:
• Anything not mentioned in the scope is considered out of scope
• Content development is OUT of scope — covered under AOR and Medical Affairs
  SOW; final signed-off content to be provided by Cingulate
• Browser/device compatibility testing = 100% coverage for 2 primary browsers
  (Chrome/Firefox/Edge) and device (Windows Desktop/Android or iOS
  Tablet/Mobile) combination using BrowserStack
• Any schedule deviation from design/content availability, MLR submissions or
  UAT signoff impacts go-live and goes through the change request process
• GEO scope covers 3 Cingulate websites; new sites or localized versions
  require revised estimates
• Market conditioning website gets end-to-end GEO benchmarking,
  recommendations and implementation support; other websites are limited to
  benchmarking, gap identification and recommendations only
• GEO team focuses on content and technical recommendations; authority and
  off-page activities (link-building, external citations) are recommendations
  only
• GEO audits/visibility tests cover up to 100 priority prompts/questions
  across 5 agreed AI assistants/bots (Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Copilot,
  Gemini, Perplexity); Cingulate to approve prompts before audit/tests
• GEO visibility tool licence waived for first six months; standard licence
  fees apply thereafter

CLIENT OBLIGATIONS: Cingulate to ensure stakeholder availability for review,
approval and UAT per schedule; approval on final designs and final approved
content; pay all charges, taxes and fees as invoiced. Subcontractors: N/A.

EARLY TERMINATION: On 30 days' written notice for convenience, Cingulate pays
(i) fees for services completed to the termination date, (ii) non-mitigable
contractual commitments, and (iii) 3 months' cost of dedicated resources.

COMMERCIALS (per SOW): Total $734,783 inclusive of pass-throughs.
Professional services by quarter — Q4 2025 $99,110; Q1 2026 $288,690;
Q2 2026 $228,491; Q3 (Jul) 2026 $61,389.
GEO component — benchmarking & preliminary analysis $34,000 (Q1 26);
GEO analysis & orchestration $50,000 (Q2 26); GEO tracking $8,000 (Jul 26).
Pass-through / out-of-pocket est. $57,103 incl. 3% admin fee $1,663 —
hosting & licensing $42,000, domains $480, EV SSL $9,600, authoritative
DNS $3,360 (reimbursed at actuals).
